{{Short description|Argentine mathematician}}
[[file:Mischa Cotlar.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Mischa Cotlar in 1964]]
'''Mischa  Cotlar''' (1913, [[Sarny]], [[Russian Empire]] – January 16, 2007, [[Buenos Aires]], [[Argentina]])<ref>{{cite news|title=Falleció el notable matemático Mischa Cotlar |trans-title=The notable mathematician Mischa Cotlar died |language=Spanish |publisher=[[La Nación]] |url=http://www.lanacion.com.ar/875902-fallecio-el-notable-matematico-mischa-cotlar |date=January 17, 2007 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20161009171143/http://www.lanacion.com.ar/875902-fallecio-el-notable-matematico-mischa-cotlar |archive-date=October 9, 2016 |url-status=dead }}</ref> was a [[mathematician]] who started his scientific career in [[Uruguay]] and worked most of his life on it in [[Argentina]] and [[Venezuela]].

His contributions to mathematics are in the fields of [[harmonic analysis]], [[ergodic theory]] and [[spectral theory]].  He introduced the [[Cotlar–Stein lemma]]. He was the author or co-author of over 80 articles in refereed journals.<ref>{{cite book|editor=Sadosky, Cora|chapter=''Introduction of Professor Mischa Cotlar to the National Academy of Exact Sciences of Argentina'' by Alberto P. Calderón|pages=xix–xx|title=Analysis and Partial Differential Equations: A Collection of Papers Dedicated to Mischa Cotlar|year=1989|publisher=CRC Press|isbn=9781482276923|chapter-url=https://books.google.com/books?id=dDFRDwAAQBAJ&pg=PR20}}</ref>

According to [[Alberto Calderón]], Cotlar showed in 1955 "that theorems on singular integrals can be generalized and put in the framework of ergodic theory."<ref>{{cite journal|author=Calderón, Alberto P.|title=Ergodic theory and translation-invariant operators|journal=Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America|volume=59|issue=2|year=1968|pages=349–353|doi=10.1073/pnas.59.2.349|pmid=16591604|pmc=224676|bibcode=1968PNAS...59..349C|doi-access=free}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|author=Cotlar, M.|title=A unified theory of Hilbert transforms and ergodic theorems|journal=Rev. Mat. Cuyana|volume=1|issue=2|year=1955|pages=105–167}}</ref> According to Krause, Lacey, and Wierdl, Karl E. Petersen in 1983 published an "especially direct proof"<ref>{{cite arXiv|author=Krause, B.|author2=Lacey, M.|author3=Wierdl, M.|year=2016|title=On convergence of modulated ergodic Hilbert transforms|class=math.CA|eprint=1610.04968}}</ref> of Cotlar's 1955 theorem.<ref>{{cite journal|author=Petersen, Karl|title=Another proof of the existence of the ergodic Hilbert transform|journal=Proc. Amer. Math. Soc.|volume=88|year=1983|issue=1|pages=39–43|doi=10.1090/S0002-9939-1983-0691275-2|mr=691275|url=https://www.ams.org/journals/proc/1983-088-01/S0002-9939-1983-0691275-2/|doi-access=free}}</ref>

In January 1994 in [[Caracas]], an international conference was held in his honor.<ref>{{cite book|editor=Marcantognini, S. A. M.|editor2=Mendoza, G. A.|editor3=Morán, M. D.|editor4=Octavio, A.|editor5=Urbina, W. O.|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=H8kaCAAAQBAJ|isbn = 9780821803042|title = Harmonic Analysis and Operator Theory: A Conference in Honor of Mischa Cotlar, January 3-8, 1994, Caracas, Venezuela|series=Contemporary Mathematics, vol. 189|year = 1995|publisher = American Mathematical Soc.}}</ref>

==Selected publications==
* Aritmética abstracta, Boletín de la Facultad de Ingeniería, Montevideo, Uruguay, 1937
* Teoría de anágenos, An. Soc. Ci. Argentina, 127, 1939
* Familias normales de funciones no analíticas, An. Soc. Ci. Argentina 129, 1940
* Un método para obtener congruencias de números de Bernoulli, Math. Notae 7, 1947
* On The Foundation Of The Ergodic Theory, Actas Symposia, UNESCO, 1951
* {{cite journal|title=On a theorem of Beurling and Kaplansky|journal=Pacific Journal of Mathematics|date=July 1954|volume=4|issue=3|pages=459–466|doi=10.2140/pjm.1954.4.459|url=https://msp.org/pjm/1954/4-3/pjm-v4-n3-s.pdf#page=141|last1=Cotlar|first1=Mischa}}
* with R. Ricabarra: {{cite journal|doi=10.2307/2372579|jstor=2372579|title=On the Existence of Characters in Topological Groups|journal=American Journal of Mathematics|year=1954|volume=76|issue=2|pages=375–388|last1=Cotlar|first1=M.|last2=Ricabarra|first2=R.}}
* A combinatorial inequality and its application to L<sup>2</sup> spaces, Math. Cuyana, 1, 1955
* {{cite journal|title=Sobre lat Teoria algebraica de la Medida y el Teorema de Hahn-Banach|journal=Revista de la Unión Matemática Argentina|volume=17|year=1956|pages=9–24|url=https://inmabb.criba.edu.ar/revuma/pdf/v17/p009-024.pdf}}
* with R. Panzone: {{cite journal|year=1960|title=Generalized potential operators|journal=Revista de la Unión Matemática Argentina|volume=19|pages=3–41|url=https://inmabb.criba.edu.ar/revuma/pdf/v19n1/p003-041.pdf}}
* Convolution Operators and Factorization, McGill Analysis Seminar, McGill University, Montreal, 1972
* {{cite book|chapter=''Moment Theory and Continuity of Hilbert and Poisson Transforms in L<sup>2</sup> Spaces'' by M. Cotlar|title=Functional Analysis, Holomorphy, and Approximation Theory|edition=1st|year=1983|publisher=CRC Press|doi=10.1201/9781003072577-4|isbn=9781003072577|s2cid=236816646|chapter-url=https://www.taylorfrancis.com/chapters/edit/10.1201/9781003072577-4/moment-theory-continuity-hilbert-poisson-transforms-l2-spaces-cotlar}}
* {{cite book|chapter=''The Helson-Szegö Theorem in L<sup>p</sup>'' by M. Cotlar and C. Sadosky|title=''In:'' Harmonic Analysis and Partial Differential Equations: Proceedings of a Conference Held April 4-5, 1988|pages=19–37|series=Contemporary Mathematics, vol. 107|publisher=American Mathematical Soc.|year=1990|isbn=9780821851135|chapter-url=https://books.google.com/books?id=YxQcCAAAQBAJ}} 
* with C. Sadosky: {{cite journal|doi=10.1006/jfan.1994.1105|title=Nehari and Nevanlinna-Pick Problems and Holomorphic Extensions in the Polydisk in Terms of Restricted BMO|year=1994|journal=Journal of Functional Analysis|volume=124|pages=205–210|last1=Cotlar|first1=M.|last2=Sadosky|first2=C.|doi-access=free}}
* with Pedro Alegría: {{cite journal|doi=10.1002/mana.19981900102|title=Generalized Toeplitz Forms and Interpolation Colligations|year=1998|journal=Mathematische Nachrichten|volume=190|pages=5–29|last1=Albgría|first1=Pedro|last2=Cotlar|first2=Mischa| s2cid=121531260 }}
